description: Intent i004 (SNAPSHOT=s01, branch=error-unwind-poisoned-count) finalized. Finding (low confidence, reported): drivers/accel/qaic/qaic_control.c:964-1010, quote "user_msg->count = le32_to_cpu(msg->hdr.count);". decode_message() parses the device/QSM control-channel reply over MHI (peer endpoint of the device protocol, analogue of the seed's remote usbip peer) and stores the device-supplied __le32 hdr.count verbatim (line 979) into the shared kernel object user_msg (struct manage_msg, kzalloc(QAIC_MANAGE_MAX_MSG_LENGTH+sizeof) in qaic_manage_ioctl:1322) with no range check. Asymmetric validation: the sibling request direction qaic_manage():1259-1261 clamps count/len against QAIC_MANAGE_MAX_MSG_LENGTH, this reply direction does not. Every failure exit in the decode loop (987 msg_len>msg_hdr_len-sizeof, 996 hdr_len/size_add, decode_passthrough -EINVAL/-ENOSPC, decode_status -ECANCELED/-EPIPE, default -EINVAL) returns without resetting the poisoned count, and qaic_manage unwinds through dma_cont_failed leaving it set; on the -ECANCELED path qaic_manage_ioctl (~1346-1351) exports msg->count to userspace. Counterevidence (why low confidence): the consuming loop re-validates each iteration against msg_hdr_len which is entry-checked <= QAIC_MANAGE_MAX_MSG_LENGTH while rsp is kmalloc(QAIC_MANAGE_MAX_MSG_LENGTH), so no kernel OOB from the count alone was demonstrated — impact is state poisoning/protocol confusion and device-controlled count propagation to userspace. Unresolved candidate: decode_status():944 validates only cumulative len against MAX, never len >= sizeof(transaction), so a minimal 8-byte declared STATUS transaction lets reads of major/minor/status/status_flags run past the declared transaction end (device-length issue, msg_xfer's actual-received-length cross-check not read). Safe candidates: qaic_manage():1259 (enforcing sibling request clamp) and s01's usbip tree, which carries the upstream seed fix — usbip_common.c:482-485 clamps rpdu->number_of_packets to <= urb->number_of_packets and recv_iso:685-693 re-validates np and resets urb->number_of_packets=0 on the error return, so the seed path is patched in s01 (and seed-excluded regardless). Limitations: bounded audit (finalize directive) — usbip family plus qaic control path only; no sweep of other s01 early-return/teardown paths (urb completion, scatterlist teardown, vhost/virtio ring cleanup, 9p/fuse request unwind, netlink/ioctl aborts); msg_xfer short-response handling unresolved; no compilation or runtime reproducer, read-only snapshot. Artifacts written: agent-state/findings/i004.json (version 1, snapshots_checked=["s01"], execution_status=complete) and updated checkpoint i004.json.
